info.title: CryptWatch API
info.description:
Open, read-only data about every coin CoinMarketCap has listed since 28 April 2013: rank history, movers,
delisted coins, year-end prices and icons. No key, no registration.

**Every JSON response** is an envelope `{"as_of": "2026-10-06", "source": "CoinMarketCap via CryptWatch",
"data": …, "page": {…}}` (`page` only on paged endpoints). Tables are also available as CSV: append `.csv` to the path.

**Caching.** Responses carry `ETag`, `Last-Modified` and `Cache-Control`. Send `If-None-Match` to get `304`.
Data changes after each import (four times a day).

**Fair use.** 60 requests per minute per IP (burst 30), otherwise `429` with `Retry-After`. Send a User-Agent
with a contact address. For complete dumps use the bulk files and `/icons/all.zip`, not the API.
Name the source: “Data: CryptWatch, based on CoinMarketCap”. Reselling the raw data as a service is not allowed.

**MCP.** The same data for AI assistants over Streamable HTTP at `/mcp`
(`{"mcpServers": {"cryptwatch": {"url": "https://cryptwat.ch/mcp"}}}`).

Errors are `{"error": {"status": 404, "code": "not_found", "message": "…"}}`.
